fear-plain.label: Fear-protecting Mace against a plain Mace with +1 damage
fear-plain.explanation: A level-29 Warrior with no fear protection of its own carries two spare Maces: one protects from fear, the other has one extra point of damage. Original: the fear protection is never recorded, so the +1 Mace scores higher, is kept as the swap weapon, and the fear-protecting Mace is offered for sale. Corrected: the fear-protection bonus applies, the fear-protecting Mace is kept and the +1 Mace is offered for sale.
